region.description: The AWS region to create resources in

secretsmanager_secret_name.description: Specifies the friendly name of the new secret. The secret name can consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and any of the following characters: /_+=.@- Conflicts with name_prefix

secretsmanager_secret_string.description: Specifies text data that you want to encrypt and store in this version of the secret.

secret_encryption_use_custom_kms_key.description: Whether to use a custom KMS key for encryption of secret

secretsmanager_recovery_window_in_days.description: Specifies the number of days that AWS Secrets Manager waits before it can delete the secret.

policy_actions.description: A list of actions to allow in the secret manager policy.

secretsmanager_version_stages.description: Specifies a list of staging labels that are attached to this version of the secret.

secretsmanager_rotation_lambda_arn.description: Specifies the ARN of the Lambda function that can rotate the secret.

secretsmanager_automatically_after_days.description: Specifies the number of days between automatic scheduled rotations of the secret.It will take affect only if `rotation_lambda_arn` value is provided.

tags.description: ey-value map of user-defined tags that are attached to the secret.
